goal: Add an attributable loop-path opt-out convention -- active/<phase>/loop-path-exempt.md with structured front-matter (phase, author, reason) -- plus a flywheel.workflow loader that locates and parses it for a given phase directory.

references: Spec FR-5 and Decisions Log -- the opt-out is a falsifiable, attributable claim ('who, which phase, why no new loop path'), not a silent escape; it must be machine-readable enough for /audit-phase to locate and re-check.
Spec Open Questions -> opt-out artifact location/format: active/<phase>/loop-path-exempt.md with front-matter is the settled shape.
constraints: Front-matter is a leading `---` ... `---` block of `key: value` lines parsed with the stdlib only (no new dependency); required keys: phase, author, reason.

The loader returns None when the file is absent, a parsed record (phase, author, reason) when present, and raises a clear error on malformed/missing-required-key front-matter -- a silently-empty opt-out must not pass as valid.
The artifact lives inside the phase dir so it travels into archive/ when the phase is archived (so /audit-phase can re-check it).
Add tests/test_loop_path_optout.py covering: absent -> None, valid -> parsed record, malformed front-matter -> error.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not wire the loader into the archive gate (archive-gate-loop-path consumes it).
Do not auto-generate opt-out content; authoring the opt-out stays human.
